content.title: Speak about GENERATIONS in English - Millennials? Gen Z? Baby Boomers?
content.text: Millennials? Gen Z? Baby Boomers? Speak about GENERATIONS in English – Advanced Vocabulary Do you know what it means when people talk about Baby Boomers, Gen X, Millennials, or Gen Z? Understanding generational vocabulary in English is essential if you want to follow news, podcasts, social media, and everyday conversations online. In this lesson, we’ll explore: ✅ What “generation” means in English ✅ The names of different generations (Greatest Generation, Silent Generation, Baby Boomers, Gen X, Millennials, Gen Z, Gen Alpha) ✅ The dates and timelines of each generation ✅ Why these words are important for culture, media, and history By the end of this video, you’ll be able to confidently recognize and use generation vocabulary like a native speaker making it easier to understand what you hear in English-speaking media.
